items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Joey DeFrancesco’s website or something else, they show you how to play bass lines

ctx.x: You know you wouldn’t have a prayer now keeping that secret because people would just go behind you and they’d take out their phone and they’d take a picture of your drawbars.

Yeah. And of course everything, I mean you can go on the Internet and see everybody’s telling you everything. All the information is there. You know I thought I was in some secret club, you know? And now you just want to learn what the settings are, and you go and Joey DeFrancesco’s website or something else, they show you how to play bass lines, they show you the settings, how to do this and that, you know. Again, it’s the idea that everything is compressed. What took us longer, now you can get all that…
Is that a good thing or a bad thing?
